fields.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of a pentagon?
fields.explanation: Sum of interior angles = (n − 2) × 180°. A pentagon has 5 sides, so (5 − 2) × 180° = 540°.
fields.hint: Split the polygon into triangles from one corner; each triangle has 180°.
fields.hintTl: Hatiin ang polygon sa triangles mula sa isang corner; bawat triangle ay 180°.
fields.whyB: 360° is the sum for a quadrilateral (4 sides).
fields.whyC: 720° is the sum for a hexagon (6 sides).
fields.explanationTl: Gamitin ang (n − 2) × 180°. Sa pentagon, n = 5, kaya 3 × 180° = 540°.

fields.explanation: Each printer prints 1 page in 2 minutes. With 4 printers working at once, 4 pages also take 2 minutes.
fields.steps:
1. 2 printers print 2 pages in 2 minutes, so 1 printer prints 1 page in 2 minutes.
2. Each of the 4 printers prints 1 page at the same time.
3. Time = 2 minutes.
fields.stepsTl:
1. 2 printers, 2 pages, 2 minutes: kaya 1 printer, 1 page, 2 minutes.
2. Sabay-sabay ang 4 printers, tig-1 page bawat isa.
3. Time = 2 minutes.
fields.hint: Find how much ONE printer does in 2 minutes first.
fields.hintTl: Alamin muna kung ilan ang kaya ng ISANG printer sa 2 minutes.
fields.whyB: 4 minutes doubles the time for double the pages, forgetting the printers also doubled.
fields.whyC: 1 minute halves the time for double the printers, forgetting the pages also doubled.
fields.whyD: 3 minutes follows no rate rule; work and printers grew by the same factor, so time stays 2.
fields.explanationTl: Ang isang printer ay 1 page kada 2 minutes. Apat na printer, apat na pages, sabay-sabay, kaya 2 minutes pa rin.
